content: Tsakeu kuwiyexinu hetsiemieme tiwawame
Hikɨ heutahaka Kerikutsie hixɨata kaniuyemiekaitɨni.
Merikɨtsɨ tewi mana kaniukateitɨni Tsakeu titewatɨ, mɨkɨ tewawamete katiniwa'aitɨwametɨkaitɨni kuwiyexinu hetsiemieme, pɨxikutɨkai.
Kanixeiyamɨkɨkaitɨni Ketsutsi kemɨpaikɨtɨkai, peru 'etsimutewikaikɨ puyutatexi teɨteri memɨyumɨirekaikɨ.
Wahɨxie 'utanautsaka wapaitɨ kanitimake xapatsie mixeiyakɨ, mana muyeyanikekaikɨ.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mana 'uyemietɨ kaneutiniere, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Tsakeu, kenakamaki xeiya. Peuyewetse 'akita nemenuanikɨ hikɨ.
Kwitɨwa kanakamake, yutemawietɨ kanitanaki'erieni yukiita.
Me'ixeiyaka yunaitɨ mekaniniukixiekaitɨni hepaɨtsitana mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «Tewi 'axatiyuruwame hetsɨa punua».

Peru Tsakeu mana 'uwetɨ mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe Ti'aitame: —Neuxei, Ti'aitame: Nepiinite hixɨata 'arɨkame nepɨtiwamini tixaɨtɨ memɨkatehexeiya, 'itarikakɨ kenemɨtiwakwamanakai hipame, naukamekɨ nepɨrapika.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kamɨ, 'ikɨ kie kiekatari meputawikweitsitɨarie hikɨ, 'ikɨta 'Apɨrahami kanixiɨyarieyatɨni.
Yuri Tewi kenemɨtitewa, nekaninuani nemɨwakuwaunenikɨ mɨkɨ memeuyexɨrie nemɨwatawikweitsitɨanikɨ.
Tumini niukiyari

Merikɨtsɨ 'ikɨ me'eniekaku tawari 'ɨxatsi hepaɨtsita tikuxatatɨ katiniwaruta'ɨkitɨani, Kerutsareme mehurakaikɨ, meta teɨteri mɨpaɨ memɨteku'eriwakaikɨ kename kwitɨ 'itsutɨanikekai ti'aitatɨ Kakaɨyari matsiɨkɨtɨ 'ayame.
Mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Tewi we'eme mɨnu'ayatɨkai tewa kaniyemiekaitɨni xeime kwieyaritsie, mana ti'aitame mayeitɨarienikɨ, 'arikeke kaninuanikekaitɨni.
Hikɨ tamamata yuhetsɨa miemete te'uximayatamete warutakwewieka yuhɨxie, tumini kaniwaru'ɨitɨani xeitsienituyari yuxexuime. Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: “Xekenemɨiriyani 'ikɨ tumini mexi nekanuawe”.
Merikɨtsɨ hetsɨana miemete kiekatari mekani'uxiwe'eriekaitɨni, niukamete mekaniwarenɨ'ani 'utɨmana mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: “Tame tepɨka'inaki'erie 'ikɨ mɨtati'aitɨakakɨ”.

»Peru mɨyatɨtɨ, ti'aitame kanayeitɨarieni. Kepauka makunua yukwieyaritsie, katiniuta'aita hetsɨana memɨ'axɨanikɨ te'uximayatamete tumini mɨwaru'ɨitɨakai, yamɨretimanikɨ yuxexuitɨ kememɨte'itimɨiriyaxɨa.
Merikɨtsɨ mexɨakame kaninuani mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: “Neti'aitɨwame, 'atumini xeitsienituyarikɨ, tamamata tsienituyari nepana'iwaxɨ”.

Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: “'Aixɨa pepɨtiuyuri, ti'uximayatame 'aixɨa pemɨtiuka'iyari pekanihɨkɨtɨni, 'etsitipaɨmeme petiuhɨritɨarieka yapemɨtikatɨakɨ, heitserie nekamenipitɨamɨkɨ tamamata kiekariyaritsie kuwexinaruri pemayanikɨ”.
Hikɨ xewitɨ kaninuani mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: “Neti'aitɨwame, 'atumini xeitsienituyarikɨ, 'auxɨwi tsienituyari nepana'iwaxɨ”.
Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: “'Ekɨta nekamanihɨritɨamɨkɨ 'auxɨwime kiekariyari”.
»Hikɨ xewitɨta kaninuani mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: “Neti'aitɨwame, kamɨ 'atumini, nepi'utakai tuwaxakɨ 'eimeme.
Nematsimakatɨ tewi pemɨti'akawawiriemɨkɨ pemɨhɨkɨkɨ: pemenu'ɨwe tita pemɨkatiyetua meta pemika'itsana tita pemɨkatiuka'e”.

Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: “Ti'uximayatame 'axapemɨtiuka'iyari, 'ahetsie pepɨrahɨpa 'akɨmana kepemutayɨ. 'Ekɨtsɨ mɨpaɨ pepɨtimaikai kenemɨtiuyukawawiriemɨkɨ, nemenu'ɨwe tita nemɨkatiyetua meta nemuka'itsana tita nemɨkatiuka'e.
Kamɨtsɨ, ¿titayari tsikere netumini pekatiyetua tumini hɨwemete wahetsɨa, ne nenuame nemɨwaye'ɨnikekai mena'iwaxɨ?”
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe mana memɨtanenierekai: “Mɨkɨ tumini xekeneunawairi, meta xekeneu'ɨitɨa 'iya tamamata tsienituyari mexeiya”.
Mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: “Ti'aitame, tamamata kanexeiyaniri mɨkɨ”.
Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe ti'aitame: “Mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, kemɨ'ane tixaɨtɨ mɨrexeiya, tawari matsi pɨtimikieni, peru kemɨ'ane mɨkarexeiya, tsepa 'etsiwa mɨrexeiya katininawaiyariemɨkɨ.
Mɨkɨ meta memɨnetsi'aye'uniekai memɨkanetsinaki'eriekai netiwa'aitɨwame nemayanikɨ, xekeniwarahapaka, nehɨxie xekeniwarukuya”».
Kerutsareme kiekariyaritsie kemɨreutaha
Merikɨtsɨ mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka kaneyani Kerutsareme tiyuneke.
Kepauka Wetɨpake meta Wetaniya kiekariyaritetsie mɨta'aximekai, yemuri Huriwa Mati'u mɨrakutewatsie hetɨa, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete yuhetsɨa miemete yuhutame kaniwarutanɨ'ani,
mɨpaɨ haitɨ: «Kiekari 'anutaɨye mukumatsie xekenehu, meta mana xemeutahaxɨanitsie, xepeitaxeiya puxu temaikɨ hakuwiekame, tewi hetsiena mɨka'anutiyerɨwe 'akuxi. Xekenakuxɨna meta xekenahani 'ena.
Xewitɨ xɨka mɨpaɨ tixeku'iwawiyani: “¿Titayari xete'ekuxɨna?”, mɨpaɨ xeketenetahɨawi: “Ti'aitame peiyehɨwa”».
Hikɨ memutanɨ'arie mekanekɨne, mekaneitaxeiya kemɨtiwarutahɨawixɨ.
Puxu temaikɨ me'akuxɨnakaku, kutsiyarimama mɨpaɨ mekateniwarutahɨawe: —¿Titayari xete'ekɨxɨna puxu temaikɨ?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniwarutahɨawe: —Ti'aitame peiyehɨwa.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi hetsɨa mekaneihana. Hikɨta yɨ'ɨkarite me'anuti'itaka puxu temaikɨ hetsie, Ketsutsi mekananutiyeni.
Kepauka mumiekai, teɨteri mekani'itɨaximekaitɨni yɨ'ɨkarite huyeta.

Hikɨ Huriwa Maku'u yemuriyari hetɨa wiyeta me'ukahutɨ, yunaitɨ teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete meyumɨiretɨ meyutemamawietɨ mekanitsutɨani karima 'aixɨa me'utiyuatɨ Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita, naime kememɨte'uxei tɨrɨkaɨyemekɨ kemɨtiuyɨ hepaɨtsita, mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ:
Hikɨ paritseutsixi hipatɨ memu'uwakai teɨteri watsata mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Ti'ɨkitame, 'ahetsɨa miemete keniwarutati'a teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete.
Mɨpaɨ mɨkɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, 'ikɨ xɨka kayuwatɨ me'umakake, tetexi pɨta mepɨtihiwakeyu.
Ketsutsi tukita
Merikɨtsɨ 'ahurawa 'umietɨ 'ixeiyaka kiekari, kaniutatsuani he'eriwatɨ,
mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —'Ekɨtɨtɨ tsikere 'ikɨ tukaritsie xɨka tɨma peheitimanike tita mɨreuyewetse para 'aixɨa pemɨtixeiyariekakɨ. Matsi kaniuti'awietsieni hikɨ 'ahɨxikɨ pemɨka'ixeiyakɨ.
Tukari kanaye'amɨkɨ, 'ana mɨkɨ memɨmatsi'aye'unie kuya tetsariyayari mekaniti'uitɨakuni 'a'aurie, 'ana 'a'aurie mekaniti'uikuni, para teɨteri memɨkawayekɨnekɨ.

Mekamanatihɨakuni kwiepa 'ekɨ meta 'ateɨterima 'ahetsie memɨyetei mepatixɨriyani kwiepa. 'Ahetsie tete xewitɨ pɨkaku'eiriwa yuheima 'atetɨ, mɨpaɨ katiniyɨmɨkɨ 'ekɨ yuri pemɨkatiuta'erikɨ kepauka Kakaɨyari munua matsitawikweitsitɨanike.
Meta Kakaɨyari tukieya kuraruyarita kaneutahani hikɨ kanitsutɨani waranuyeweweiyatɨ muwa memɨtetuakai,
mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «'Ipaɨ katine'uka: “Nekii nenewieri kiyari pɨhɨkɨtɨni”. Peru xeme terɨ xekanayeitɨani “hakewa tenawayamete memeyu'awieta”».

Merikɨtsɨ tukarikɨ katini'ɨkitakaitɨni tuki kuraruyarita, mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete, meta 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitametetɨkai, meta teɨteri wa'ukiyarima yunaitɨ mekanikuwautɨwekaitɨni me'imienike.
Peru mɨkɨ mekaniyutatexieni mɨpaɨ meteyurienike, yunaitɨ teɨteri memi'eniekaikɨ me'ihiwe'erietɨ niukieya.
